0x20.INPUT: decrypted baseline image plus cached image base and runtime classifier configuration
0x20.NEXT_STAGE_BRANCH: acquisition success permits stage2; post-stage2 enum selects keep/update image base

0x50.INPUT: A0/0x50 dynamic NAV body (2409 bytes) plus cached NAV base and runtime classifier configuration
0x50.NEXT_STAGE_BRANCH: acquisition success always permits stage1; post-stage2 enum selects keep/update NAV base, not stage2 admission
0x50.OUTPUT: stored NAV buffer, then classifier enum 0..3 after stage2

0x82.INPUT: ChipRegRead register 0x0082 quantity 2; unsigned raw FDT base0/base1 words
0x82.NEXT_STAGE_BRANCH: all abs(base0[i]-base1[i]) <= threshold -> baseline image; violation -> cached-base fallback or rebuild loop
0x82.OUTPUT: threshold = zero_extend(response[1]); response[0] ignored on this path

orchestrator.INPUT: loaded target base/cache state plus sensor callbacks
orchestrator.OUTPUT: base update/reuse result consumed by caller 0x180068940
